subject: Private/VPC security posture — follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC security posture — follow-up & next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups from our side: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
- Can you confirm your current SOC 2 status (in-scope, report available, or anticipated completion date)?
- Any region-specific compliance (GDPR/HIPAA) we should account for on the deployment?

2) Deployment preference & isolation
- You mentioned preference for network isolation. Redwood supports: Hosted (shared), Dedicated VPC (customer VPC peering or PrivateLink), and on-prem/air-gapped packages. Can you confirm whether you need a VPC peering solution vs. fully air-gapped on-prem?

3) Security questionnaire
- We typically send a short vendor security questionnaire to capture specifics (KMS/HSM, data residency, logging, breach notification). Would you like us to initiate that now? I can send the link and attach our high-level architecture diagram.

4) Next steps / proposed timeline
- If SOC 2 and GDPR/HIPAA are blockers, we can schedule a dedicated security call next week to go through the technical details and deployment diagrams (30–45 min).
- I'll attach a high-level VPC diagram and an on-prem diagram for your security team to review.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-highlevel.pdf (high-level architecture)

Proposed meeting windows (PT):
- Thu 2027-04-22 10:00–10:45
- Fri 2027-04-23 09:30–10:15

Let me know which works and any specific engineers/security folks to loop in.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC security posture — follow-up & next steps

Hi Marcus — great call, thanks. Quick answers: 

- SOC 2: In progress (Type II expected Q3 2027). We have a Type I report from last year; Type II is on our roadmap.
- GDPR: Yes, applies to parts of our EU user base.
- HIPAA: Potentially in scope for specific PII datasets; we'll need to confirm with compliance.

We are very interested in a Dedicated VPC first (peering/PrivateLink) — air-gapped on-prem would be a heavier lift, but we want to understand what that would look like for a later phase. 

Please send the vendor security questionnaire link and the VPC / on-prem diagrams. Curious specifically about: KMS/HSM support for key management, audit logs retention and formats, ability to restrict egress, and how KV cache is handled for private deployments.

I can join the security call — I will loop Oliver (platform security) and our infra lead if needed. Thu 4/22 10:00 PT works for me.

—Emily
Emily Chen
Head of InfoSec, FinHealth
emily.chen@finhealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@finhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC security posture — follow-up & next steps

Emily — thanks for the quick details and for confirming Thu 4/22 10:00 PT. 

Answers inline and next steps: 

- SOC 2: Understood — Type II in Q3 is fine; for procurement we can share our SOC 2 Type II once available and in the meantime provide our security whitepaper and controls map.

- GDPR/HIPAA: We'll treat GDPR as in-scope; HIPAA will require additional controls (BAA discussion). I'll flag our compliance team to prepare BAA materials if FinHealth confirms HIPAA scope.

- Dedicated VPC: Redwood supports VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, and customer-managed VPC deployments. For Dedicated we can:
  * Deploy inference nodes in isolated subnets
  * Optional egress restrictions via NAT & firewall rules
  * KMS integration (customer-managed keys) — we support AWS KMS CMKs and HSM integrations for private deployments.

- KV cache / data handling: For private/Dedicated deployments we can disable shared caching and ensure KV caches are colocated and isolated per customer; we can also provide retention/flush policies on request.

I've attached a slightly more detailed on-prem deployment diagram (redwood-onprem-deploy-diagram.png) and re-attached the high-level VPC PDF. I've also created a vendor security questionnaire entry for FinHealth here: https://redwood.app/sq/finhealth-2027 (tokenized link). Please use that to upload your vendor questionnaire or let us know if you prefer to send a PDF.

Next steps (action items):
- Marcus: Send diagrams + SQ link (done)
- FinHealth: Upload completed SQ / confirm HIPAA in-scope? (Emily)
- Neha: I left a placeholder in HubSpot and created DEAL-2027-0143 to track procurement.
- Schedule: Security call Thu 4/22 10:00 PT — Marcus, Emily, Oliver, Rishi, Neha. 

Attachments: redwood-onprem-deploy-diagram.png, redwood-vpc-highlevel.pdf

Thanks — see you on Thursday.

Marcus
